subject.title: fix(browser): keep guarded CDP sockets on validated endpoints [AI]

question: Should plugin manifest command aliases become the supported source of root CLI help metadata and suppress plugin `cli-metadata.*` loading when that metadata is present?
rationale: This is a new plugin manifest and loader contract, not a mechanical requirement for the CDP socket security repair; its compatibility and long-term API direction need explicit owner approval.

options.title: Split and decide separately
options.body: Remove the manifest CLI metadata changes from this PR and review that plugin API direction independently after auditing installed-plugin compatibility.

options.title: Sponsor the manifest contract
options.body: Keep the metadata work only with explicit plugin API approval, compatibility coverage for existing CLI metadata modules, and documentation of the upgrade contract.

recommendation.title: Split and decide separately
recommendation.body: Remove the manifest CLI metadata changes from this PR and review that plugin API direction independently after auditing installed-plugin compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the author of both the Browser and plugin-loader proposals; a current-main plugin API owner could not be established from the available evidence.
